study type: Nested case-control study within a prospective cohort
exposure: Amniotic fluid concentrations of placenta growth factor (PlGF)
cohort: A cohort of 382 pregnant women undergoing early second-trimester genetic amniocentesis was enrolled and followed-up until delivery.
finding: Amniotic fluid PlGF levels in the early second trimester were significantly higher in women who delivered preterm compared to those with term delivery, especially for early preterm cases.
